gambade.plugin_files_note: Écrits seulement dans les bras avec plugin, masqués de git par info/exclude. rules.json suit le schéma v1 de la garde (validé en strict par --check-tasks) : OUI = violation.

rules.question: Does the change add a user-visible text literal in UI code instead of reading it from a strings class in lib/l10n?
rules.true: A string shown to the user is hardcoded in a widget or screen
rules.false: Visible text comes from a context.l10n strings getter, or the literal is not user-visible (keys, logs, asserts)
rules.message: Texte visible en dur : le définir dans lib/l10n/strings_<module>.dart (fr et en) et le lire via context.l10n….

rules.question: Does the change add an em dash inside a user-visible French or English string?
rules.true: A text shown to the user contains the em dash character
rules.false: No em dash in displayed text; em dashes in comments or docs do not count
rules.message: Tiret cadratin interdit dans les textes affichés : virgule ou reformuler.

examples.after: // Deux instances const — jamais instanciées ailleurs.

rules.question: Does the change add a French user-visible string where a question mark or an exclamation mark follows a regular space or no space instead of a non-breaking space?
rules.true: A French displayed string has a normal space, or no space, before ? or !
rules.false: Every ? and ! in French strings follows a non-breaking space, or the string is English
rules.message: Français : espace insécable (\u00A0) avant « ? » et « ! » dans les textes affichés.

rules.question: Does the change do calendar-day arithmetic on local midnights, with subtract or add of Duration(days: n) or difference().inDays, instead of UTC midnights?
rules.true: Days are counted or stepped on local DateTime values, which breaks on the 23 h and 25 h days around DST changes
rules.false: Day arithmetic uses UTC midnights (DateTime.utc, _dateOnlyUtc), or the change does no calendar-day arithmetic
rules.message: Arithmétique de jours : passer par des minuits UTC (_dateOnlyUtc), jamais par des minuits locaux (DST).

rules.question: Does the change add I/O, a Flutter import or a direct DateTime.now() call to domain code instead of taking the time from the caller?
rules.true: Domain code reads the clock, imports Flutter, or performs I/O (files, network, database, preferences)
rules.false: Domain code stays pure: time and data are passed in by the caller
rules.message: Domaine pur : ni I/O ni import Flutter, et le temps (now) est injecté par l'appelant.

examples.after: static int? daysSinceLastWalk(Iterable<DateTime> walks, {required DateTime now}) {

rules.question: Does the change add a second copy of an existing rule, guard or helper instead of calling the existing one?
rules.true: The change re-implements logic that already exists as a helper in the project, such as a date-only conversion or an id check
rules.false: The change calls the existing helper, or the logic is genuinely new
rules.message: Jamais deux copies d'une garde : réutiliser le helper existant (par exemple _dateOnlyUtc).

examples.after: final last = _dateOnlyUtc(walks.reduce((a, b) => a.isAfter(b) ? a : b));

rules.question: Does the change call pumpAndSettle in a widget test instead of pumping fixed durations?
rules.false: Tests pump fixed durations step by step, or do not pump at all
rules.message: Jamais pumpAndSettle (animations infinies) : pumper des durées fixes.

pioudex.plugin_files_note: Écrits seulement dans les bras avec plugin, masqués de git par info/exclude. rules.json suit le schéma v1 de la garde (validé en strict par --check-tasks) : OUI = violation.

rules.question: Does the change add a user-visible text literal in Dart code instead of reading it from the ARB localizations?
rules.true: A string shown to the user is hardcoded in Dart
rules.false: Visible text comes from an l10n getter backed by app_fr.arb, or the literal is not user-visible (keys, logs, asserts)
rules.message: Texte visible en dur : ajouter la clé dans lib/l10n/app_fr.arb et la lire via l10n.

rules.question: Does the change add a key to app_fr.arb without a matching @key entry that carries a non-empty description?
rules.true: A new ARB key has no @key metadata, or its description is empty
rules.false: Every new key has an @key entry with a non-empty description
rules.message: Chaque clé ARB ajoutée porte une description non vide (@clé).

rules.question: Does the change use an ARB placeholder or an ICU plural or select message instead of separate singular and plural keys composed in Dart?
rules.true: An ARB text contains a {placeholder} or {count, plural, ...}, or Dart calls a parameterized l10n method
rules.false: Counts are composed in Dart from separate fixed singular and plural keys
rules.message: Ni placeholder ni pluriel ICU dans l'ARB : clés singulier et pluriel séparées, composées en Dart.

rules.question: Does the change use a hardcoded color value, a Material Colors constant, or a new token that duplicates an existing PioudexColors value?
rules.true: A color is written as a literal or Material constant outside tokens.dart, or a new token repeats an existing value
rules.false: Colors come from existing PioudexColors tokens, or a genuinely new value is added once in lib/theme/tokens.dart
rules.message: Couleurs : tokens PioudexColors uniquement (lib/theme/tokens.dart), sans valeur en dur ni token jumeau.

rules.question: Does the change add French UI text that uses vous, reassurance or filler words, an em dash, an emoji, or more than two sentences?
rules.true: The new text breaks the app voice: vouvoiement, bientôt, pour l'instant, pas encore, vraiment, em dash, emoji or a long explanation
rules.false: The text is short and factual, uses tu, with no reassurance, em dash or emoji
rules.message: Voix : tutoiement, factuel et court (deux phrases au plus), sans réassurance, tiret cadratin ni emoji.

examples.after: "captureVide": "Pas encore de chant ? Ne vous inquiétez pas, ça viendra bientôt !",

rules.question: Does the change add a Material or Cupertino switch widget instead of the app's own _Interrupteur toggle?
rules.true: A Switch, SwitchListTile or CupertinoSwitch is added
rules.false: Toggles reuse _Interrupteur, or the change adds no toggle
rules.message: Interrupteurs : réutiliser _Interrupteur de l'app, pas un Switch Material ou Cupertino.
